inv.desc_en:
Fantastic Premises for rent located on Ronda de Sant Pere in the heart of the Barrio de l´eixample in Barcelona. It has an approximate area of about 250 m2 currently with removable divisions, 8 rooms + 1 meeting room, office, 3 toilets, stoneware floor, false ceiling with low-consumption halogens. Perimeter facilities, hot-cold air conditioning splits. Area of influence of offices and semi-commercial. Abundant pedestrian flow and good communications through public transport, buses, metro, and ffcc.
It does not have a smoke outlet.
Businesses NOT SUITABLE for the premises, hospitality-cafeterias, coworkings.
For more information CONSULT US!
Possibility of staggered rent to consult with the property.
Deposit 2 months
Additional guarantees depending on solvency.
